named-query.name: Action.findAllByUser
named-query.query: SELECT a FROM Action a WHERE a.user = :user ORDER BY a.date DESC

named-query.name: Action.findLastActions
named-query.query: SELECT a FROM Action a LEFT JOIN a.user u ORDER BY a.date DESC

named-query.name: Bookmark.find
named-query.query: SELECT b FROM Bookmark b WHERE b.user = :user AND b.entityClass = :entityClass AND b.entityId = :entityId

named-query.name: Bookmark.findAllByClassAndId
named-query.query: SELECT b FROM Bookmark b WHERE b.entityClass = :entityClass AND b.entityId = :entityId

named-query.name: Bookmark.findAllByUser
named-query.query: SELECT b FROM Bookmark b WHERE b.user = :user

named-query.name: Candidate.findAllDataById
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Candidate c LEFT JOIN FETCH c.files LEFT JOIN FETCH c.tags LEFT JOIN FETCH c.jobCandidatures WHERE c.id = :id

named-query.name: Candidate.findByNameAndSurname
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Candidate c WHERE (:name IS NOT NULL AND c.name = :name) OR (:surname IS NOT NULL AND c.surname = :surname)

named-query.name: Candidate.findByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Candidate c LEFT JOIN c.jobCandidatures jc WHERE jc.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: Candidate.findLastAddedCandidates
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Candidate c ORDER BY c.id DESC

named-query.name: Candidate.emailExists
named-query.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (COUNT(c) > 0) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM Candidate c WHERE c.email = :email

named-query.name: Candidate.numberOfCandidates
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(c) FROM Candidate c

named-query.name: Client.findByClientId
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Client c LEFT JOIN FETCH c.contacts LEFT JOIN FETCH c.jobOffers WHERE c.id = :clientId

named-query.name: Client.findByName
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Client c WHERE c.name = :name

named-query.name: Client.clientExist
named-query.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (COUNT(c) > 0) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM Client c WHERE c.name = :name

named-query.name: Contact.findByClient
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Contact c WHERE c.client = :client

named-query.name: Curriculum.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Curriculum c LEFT JOIN FETCH c.candidate LEFT JOIN FETCH c.education LEFT JOIN FETCH c.jobExperiences LEFT JOIN FETCH c.languages LEFT JOIN FETCH c.skills WHERE c.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: I18n.findByKeyAndLocale
named-query.query: SELECT i FROM I18nString i WHERE i.key = :key AND i.locale= :locale

named-query.name: JobCandidature.findByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidature j WHERE j.jobOffer.id = :jobOfferId

named-query.name: JobCandidature.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidature j WHERE j.candidate.id = :candidateId

named-query.name: JobCandidature.findByJobOfferAndCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidature j WHERE j.candidate = :candidate AND j.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: JobExperience.findByCurriculum
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobExperience j WHERE j.curriculum = :curriculum

named-query.name: JobMeeting.findPlannedJobMeetings
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobMeeting j WHERE j.datePlanned IS NOT NULL AND j.dateConducted IS NULL

named-query.name: JobMeeting.findConductedJobMeetings
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobMeeting j WHERE j.dateConducted IS NOT NULL

named-query.name: JobMeeting.findByUserAndCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobMeeting j WHERE j.user = :user

named-query.name: JobOffer.findAllByOwner
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j WHERE j.owner = :owner AND j.deleted <> TRUE

named-query.name: JobOffer.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j INNER JOIN j.jobCandidatures jc WHERE jc.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: JobOffer.findByClient
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j WHERE j.client = :client

named-query.name: JobOffer.findByName
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j WHERE j.name = :name

named-query.name: JobOffer.findLastJobOffers
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j WHERE j.owner = :owner ORDER BY j.id

named-query.name: Role.findAdmin
named-query.query: SELECT r FROM Role r WHERE r.name = 'ADMIN'

named-query.name: Role.findRoleByName
named-query.query: SELECT r FROM Role r WHERE r.name = :name

named-query.name: Role.findSubordinateRoles
named-query.query: SELECT r FROM RoleClosure rc JOIN rc.descendant r WHERE rc.antecessor = :antecessor

named-query.name: ServerFile.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT s FROM ServerFile s WHERE s.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: User.findById
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u LEFT JOIN FETCH u.role WHERE u.id = :id

named-query.name: User.findByEmail
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u LEFT JOIN FETCH u.role WHERE u.email = :email

named-query.name: User.findSubordinateUsers
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM UserClosure uc JOIN uc.descendant u WHERE uc.antecessor.id = :id AND uc.pathLength > 0

named-query.name: User.findAll
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u LEFT JOIN FETCH u.role

named-query.name: User.findByNameAndSurname
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u LEFT JOIN FETCH u.role WHERE (:name IS NOT NULL AND u.name = :name) OR (:surname IS NOT NULL AND u.surname = :surname)

named-query.name: User.findUser
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u WHERE (:name IS NOT NULL AND u.name = :name) OR (:surname IS NOT NULL AND u.surname = :surname)

named-query.name: User.findUsersOffline
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u WHERE u.lastConnection NOT BETWEEN :start and :end OR u.lastConnection IS NULL

named-query.name: User.numberOfUsersOffline
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(u) FROM User u WHERE u.lastConnection NOT BETWEEN :start and :end OR u.lastConnection IS NULL

named-query.name: User.findUsersOnline
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u WHERE u.lastConnection BETWEEN :start and :end

named-query.name: User.numberOfUsersOnline
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(u) FROM User u WHERE u.lastConnection BETWEEN :start and :end

named-query.name: User.numberOfUsersInTeam
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT (u) FROM UserClosure uc JOIN uc.descendant u WHERE uc.antecessor.id = :id AND uc.pathLength > 0

named-query.name: User.existsMoreThanOneAdmin
named-query.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (COUNT(u) > 1) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM User u WHERE u.role.name = 'ADMIN'

named-query.name: User.emailExists
named-query.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (COUNT(u) > 0) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM User u WHERE u.email = :email

named-query.name: UserClosure.findAntecessorsUserClosuresById
named-query.query: SELECT uc FROM UserClosure uc WHERE uc.descendant.id = :id

named-query.name: UserClosure.findDescendantsUserClosuresById
named-query.query: SELECT uc FROM UserClosure uc WHERE uc.antecessor.id = :id
